text:
Maya: Quick poll  should the new rollback/fallback UI default to 'silent' for auto-fallbacks? want low noise for transient errors.
Jon: yes for default. ops can enable louder alerts per rollout.
Priya: agree but we need clear visibility: tiny badge + sampled traces link. no hidden states.
Oliver: telemetry implication  sample at router, tag sampling_id and error_class. store full blob only for sampled ids. cheaper and searchable.
Maya: good. also add escalation rule: percent>3% over 5m triggers operator notify. configurable per-customer.
Jon: api proto: {"fallback_mode":"silent","audit_rate":0.01,"escalation":{"percent":3,"window_s":300},"notify_operator":false}
Priya: UX: badge says "Silent fallback (sampled)" hover shows threshold and "promote to loud" button.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: feature flag roll started (5% canary) for auto-fallback-silent. see https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/1758889999
